content: Currently, our communication is text-based, meaning we can exchange messages through typing, but we can't use microphones or speakers for voice conversations. However, if your device has text-to-speech or voice assistant features, you might be able to have the device read aloud my responses or let you dictate your messages using voice input. Let me know how I can help! 🎤🔊
